This evening, tribute to the senior coordinator
The new month is here
Calm Skies for Every Companion

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk offers a steady hand for travelers and a careful ear for staff notes. The safety coordinator continues to review hazards and prevention with close attention, while the cabin team keeps watch over animals during flight and the supervisors listen closely when a passenger is worried. <<FACT F021>> Clear guidance, patient follow-up, and respectful care remain at the center of each journey. We thank every colleague who helps keep each departure orderly, humane, and reassuring.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
